programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.sub-title: Aliens Uncovered: ET or Man-Made Part 1
programme.desc: The crash of Roswell wasn't meant for New Mexico. In 1947, a neighboring state had 3 major sightings that were swept under the rug. With The Phoenix Light's and Travis Walton's "Fire in the Sky", there's a rich history of UFO involvement in Arizona. This film focuses on fresh UFO content from present day, containing interviews from residents and law enforcement officers statewide.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: An elderly couple is shot in their upstate New York home - no witnesses, no apparent motive. Detectives struggle to develop suspects, but without evidence to tie their suspects to the killing, their investigation stalls. The case gets a boost when psychic Noreen Renier confirms the investigators' suspicions, and even leads them to a new clue. Halfway across the country, the sudden disappearance of a young mother shocks a small Ohio town. The woman's husband - a cop - claims she left him, but her parents and police aren't so sure. Psychic Georgia Rudolph helps lead police to the truth.

programme.title: Real Fear: The Truth Behind More Movies
programme.sub-title: Real Fear: The Truth Behind More Movies - Part 2
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Katrina Weidman (Paranormal State), Richard Dolan (Syfy Investigates), John McGarry, Chris Holt and Becky Weingrad travel across the country in search of America's darkest mysteries -- a road trip into the unknown.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Could implantable RFID chips or Radio-frequency identification tags currently in widespread use in retail industry be used to surreptitiously track and control people? Richard speaks with several researchers who believe RFID chips present a serious threat to privacy and civil liberties. A professor of computer science and a skeptic argues that fear that RFID chips will be used to control and track humans is rooted in paranoia, not scientific fact. Further, he maintains RFID chips do not have the capability of long-range surveillance.

programme.title: Virginia Paranormal Case Files
programme.sub-title: History and Haunts of the Park Gate Plantation - Part 3
programme.desc: The team at Virginia Paranormal Investigations travels the state investigating claims of paranormal activity and compiling the Virginia Paranormal Case Files. The show offers a balanced look at paranormal investigation. VAPI has a reputation for being honest and approaching each case with an open mind. The evidence is real, the people are real, and the reports are real.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: On this episode of Eric Mintel Investigates, Lead investigator Eric Mintel and Spirit Medium, Dominic Sattele travel to the beautiful town Manchester, CT to investigate the historic Cheney Hall. Strange sounds, strong energies and the shadow of a woman in 18th century dress have been reported over the years. Along the way Eric and Dominic learn of all the rich history of Cheney Hall and the Cheney Brothers who put Manchester on the map and how we discovered one of the finest towns in America. Sit back and enjoy this latest adventure from Eric Mintel Investigates and wait until you see what gave Dominic "Chills at Cheney Hall!"

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric gets a call from legendary UFO researcher and Roswell crash expert and author Tom Carey. Tom has just received many eyewitness reports of an upright canine dogma type cryptid seen in the Bryn Athyn Pennsylvania area called the Bryn Athyn Beast. Eric and Tom meet with three eyewitnesses in the locations that they had their sightings. Later Spirit medium Dominic Sattele joins the team with magnetometer readings that go off the charts in the areas where the creature has been sighted. What follows is a whirlwind investigation leaving the team speechless!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Lead investigator Eric Mintel and Pyschic medium Julie Kraus embark on a journey through the railways of Bucks County on the New Hope Railroad while stopping along the rails at various paranormal hot spots. The investigation takes an otherworldly turn when Julie is confronted by an unknown entitiy that sends the investigation into overdrive!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Do spirits or ghosts inhabit the Exeter Community Library in Exeter Township, Berks County, PA? Paranormal investigators Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele are joined by local historian and author Charles J. Adams, III to look into the matter!

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Lead investigator, Eric Mintel and spirit medium Dominic Sattele, recalled eerie occurrences during their initial investigation in 2018, suddenly found themselves plunged into an electrifying atmosphere once again. This time, however, the stakes were raised as Dominic Sattele, wielding his extraordinary mediumship abilities, unleashed an unforeseen connection with the otherworldly.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.sub-title: A Haunting at the Hanoverville Roadhouse
programme.desc: Eric and Dominic get a call to come investigate some creepy goings on at the Hanoverville Roadhouse in Bethlehem, PA. What lurks in the shadows in as Eric Mintel Investigates, A Haunting at the Hanoverville Roadhouse.

programme.title: Eric Mintel Investigates
programme.desc: Eric and his team delve into the eerie history of the Jenkintown Library, a historic landmark with secrets lurking in the shadows. Joined by spirit medium Dominic Sattele, they tap into the energy of otherworldly entities believed to haunt the building. With Library Director Nina Meister, they uncover chilling activity no one ever suspected, revealing the library’s hidden, supernatural past. Prepare for a spine-tingling journey into the unknown as Eric Mintel and his team investigate the mysteries of this haunted location!

Sit back with your favorite vino and enjoy the latest video from Eric Mintel Investigates!
